parts.body: Hi Veltrix team — we experienced significant downtime on April 22nd and 23rd affecting our trading systems integration. Based on the SLA terms in our contract, we believe we are entitled to a credit. Our internal estimate puts the impact at roughly $900. Can you initiate the credit process?

Hi Margaret, I am sorry for the disruption this caused. I have logged this as incident INC-8841 in our system. Given the SLA classification and duration of impact, I will escalate to our VP of Support for formal credit authorization. We aim to respond within 2 business days.

Update from our team: our VP of Support has completed the review of incident INC-8841 and has authorized a credit for Hartwell Financial Group. The official signed authorization form is being processed and you will receive confirmation along with your records.
Received the authorization form - thank you for handling this promptly. Happy with the resolution.
Our services are hitting the 1000 req/min API limit on the compute provisioning endpoint. Can you increase this for our account?
Hi James - done. I have bumped your limit to 2500 req/min effective immediately. Let us know if you need further adjustments.
We are seeing elevated latency on compute provisioning calls this afternoon - p99 is sitting around 4 seconds. Is there a platform-side issue?
Hi Samira - we are investigating. Our on-call team has been paged. I will update you as soon as we have more information.
